I’m CareerBot, a rule-based intent-matching chatbot built with Python, Flask, and scikit-learn.
I can respond to common questions about Python, web development, interview preparation, and this demo. I use intent similarity, so I may not understand every phrasing.
Python is a general-purpose language popular for automation, web backends, data analysis, and machine learning. Start with variables, conditions, loops, functions, collections, and small projects.

A useful web-development path is HTML and CSS, JavaScript, responsive design, HTTP and REST APIs, then a framework such as React and a backend such as Flask or FastAPI. Build and deploy small projects as you learn.

For entry-level developer interviews, practise arrays, strings, hash maps, sorting, binary search, and basic trees; revise OOP, DBMS, OS, and networking; and prepare clear explanations of your own projects.

Keep your resume concise and evidence-based. For each project, state the problem, your implementation, the technologies used, and a measurable result only when you can verify it. Add GitHub links and a working demo where possible.
This is an educational demo and has no live support team. You can improve its answers by editing the patterns and responses in intents.json.
This demo is built with Python, Flask, scikit-learn TF-IDF vectorization, cosine similarity, and an editable JSON intent file.
